quote: We collect the model's responses on the reserved test prompts.
We select two tasks: positive generation and single-turn safe conversation. For the former, we use the data classified as positive or negative in the IMDb dataset ...

We validate tasks involving two opposing characteristics (e.g. safe and unsafe). We first train slices {θ 1, θ 2, ..., θ n } based on a pre-trained model θ 0 using positive (e.g., safe) data of various volumes. Then we perform inverse finetuning on these slices using negative data (i.e., unsafe).
outputs: generated responses for positive style generation and single-turn safe dialogue

quote: For positive style generation, we refer to and use the Sentiment Roberta model to classify the responses, taking the proportion of all responses classified as positive as the model score. For single-turn safe dialogue, we use the cost model to score the safety of each response, using the average score of all responses as the model score.
